caption: The drawing depicts an oval-shaped object filled with a colorful composition. At the center, two human figures stand side by side; the figure on the left wears a long pinkish-red garment with a white collar and a black hat, while the figure on the right wears a yellow coat with white dots, a green sash, and also a black hat. Surrounding them are large, stylized flowers and leaves in shades of pink, red, green, and blue, filling the background. The upper part features a tent-like brown and green structure with yellow stars. Below the figures, there is a rectangular band with a line of text written in a script, colored in yellow on a red background. The lower section of the object displays additional floral motifs in red, pink, and green. The overall background color of the oval is dark, mostly black, which makes the colors of the figures and flowers stand out. There is also a lightly sketched oval object to the right side on the plain beige background outside the central oval.
title: Pa. German Hat Box
